045        public void applyMaxCRCrewModifiers(FleetMemberAPI member) {
046                if (member == null || member.getStats() == null) return;
047                
048//              if (member.getFleetData() != null && member.getFleetData().getFleet() != null &&
049//                              //member.getFleetData().getFleet().getName().contains("Ryan") &&
050//                               member.getCrewFraction() < 1f) {
051//                      System.out.println("efwefwefwefe");
052//              }
053                
054                //float maxCRBasedOnLevel = (40f + member.getCrewFraction() * 10f) / 100f;
055                float maxCRBasedOnLevel = 0.7f;
056                member.getStats().getMaxCombatReadiness().modifyFlat("crew skill bonus", maxCRBasedOnLevel, "Basic maintenance");
057                
058                float cf = member.getCrewFraction();
059                if (cf < 1) {
060                        float penalty = 0.5f * (1f - cf);
061                        //float penalty = (1f - cf);
062                        member.getStats().getMaxCombatReadiness().modifyFlat("crew understrength", -penalty, "Crew understrength");
063                } else {
064                        member.getStats().getMaxCombatReadiness().unmodifyFlat("crew understrength");
065                }
066        }

070        public List<CRStatusItemData> getCRStatusDataForShip(ShipAPI ship) {
071                float startingCR = ship.getCRAtDeployment();
072                float cr = ship.getCurrentCR();
073                
074                List<CRStatusItemData> list = new ArrayList<CRStatusItemData>();
075                
076                String icon = null;
077                
078                if (cr > getImproveThreshold(ship.getMutableStats())) {
079                        icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("ui", "icon_tactical_cr_bonus");
080                } else if (cr < getDegradeThreshold(ship.getMutableStats())) {
081                        icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("ui", "icon_tactical_cr_penalty");
082                } else {
083                        icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("ui", "icon_tactical_cr_neutral");
084                        //return list;
085                }
086                
087                String title = "Combat Readiness " + Math.round(cr * 100f) + "%";
088                
089                String malfStr = getMalfunctionString(ship.getMutableStats(), cr);
090                
091                if (cr <= NO_SYSTEM_THRESHOLD && ship.getShield() != null) {
092                        CRStatusItemData itemData = new CRStatusItemData(statusKeys[9], icon, title,
093                                        "Shields offline", true);
094                        list.add(itemData);
095                }
096                
097                if (cr <= NO_SYSTEM_THRESHOLD) {
098                        boolean hasWings = false;
099                        for (FighterLaunchBayAPI bay : ship.getLaunchBaysCopy()) {
100                                if (bay.getWing() != null) {
101                                        hasWings = true;
102                                        break;
103                                }
104                        }
105                        if (hasWings) {
106                                CRStatusItemData itemData = new CRStatusItemData(statusKeys[10], icon, title,
107                                                "Fighter bays offline", true);
108                                list.add(itemData);
109                        }
110                }
111                
112                if (cr <= NO_SYSTEM_THRESHOLD && ship.getPhaseCloak() != null) {
113                        CRStatusItemData itemData = new CRStatusItemData(statusKeys[8], icon, title,
114                                        ship.getPhaseCloak().getDisplayName() + " offline", true);
115                        list.add(itemData);
116                }
117                
118                if (cr <= NO_SYSTEM_THRESHOLD && ship.getSystem() != null) {
119                        CRStatusItemData itemData = new CRStatusItemData(statusKeys[7], icon, title,
120                                         ship.getSystem().getDisplayName() + " offline", true);
121                        list.add(itemData);
122                }
123                
124                if (cr < getMalfunctionThreshold(ship.getMutableStats())) {
125                        CRStatusItemData itemData = new CRStatusItemData(statusKeys[0], icon, title,
126                                         "malfunction risk: " + malfStr, true);
127                        list.add(itemData);
128                }
129                if (startingCR < getMissileAmmoReductionThreshold(ship.getMutableStats())) {
130                        CRStatusItemData itemData = new CRStatusItemData(statusKeys[2], icon, title,
131                                         "missiles not fully loaded", true);
132                        list.add(itemData);
133                }
134                
135                if (cr < getDegradeThreshold(ship.getMutableStats())) {
136                        CRStatusItemData itemData = new CRStatusItemData(statusKeys[3], icon, title,
137                                        "degraded performance", true);
138                        list.add(itemData);
139                } else if (cr > getImproveThreshold(ship.getMutableStats())) {
140                        CRStatusItemData itemData = new CRStatusItemData(statusKeys[4], icon, title,
141                                        "improved performance", false);
142                        list.add(itemData);
143                } else {
144                        CRStatusItemData itemData = new CRStatusItemData(statusKeys[8], icon, title,
145                                        "standard performance", false);
146                        list.add(itemData);
147                }
148                
149                if (ship.losesCRDuringCombat() && cr > 0) {
150                        //float noLossTime = ship.getHullSpec().getNoCRLossTime();
151                        float noLossTime = ship.getMutableStats().getPeakCRDuration().computeEffective(ship.getHullSpec().getNoCRLossTime());
152                        if (noLossTime > ship.getTimeDeployedForCRReduction()) {
153                                CRStatusItemData itemData = new CRStatusItemData(statusKeys[5], icon, "peak active performance",
154                                                "remaining time: " + (int) (noLossTime - ship.getTimeDeployedForCRReduction()) + " sec", false);
155                                list.add(itemData);
156                        } else {
157                                CRStatusItemData itemData = new CRStatusItemData(statusKeys[6], icon, "combat stresses",
158                                                "degrading readiness", true);
159                                list.add(itemData);
160                        }
161                }
162                
163                return list;
164        }

167        private float getWeaponMalfuctionPercent(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, float cr) {
168                return MAX_WEAPON_MALFUNCTION_CHANCE * (getMalfunctionThreshold(stats) - cr) / getMalfunctionThreshold(stats);
169        }
170        private float getEngineMalfuctionPercent(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, float cr) {
171                return MAX_ENGINE_MALFUNCTION_CHANCE * (getMalfunctionThreshold(stats)- cr) / getMalfunctionThreshold(stats);
172        }
173        private float getCriticalMalfuctionPercent(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, float cr) {
174                return MAX_CRITICAL_MALFUNCTION_CHANCE * (getCriticalMalfunctionThreshold(stats)- cr) / getCriticalMalfunctionThreshold(stats);
175        }
176        private float getShieldMalfuctionPercent(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, float cr) {
177                return MAX_SHIELD_MALFUNCTION_CHANCE * (getShieldMalfunctionThreshold(stats)- cr) / getShieldMalfunctionThreshold(stats);
178        }

181        private float getMovementChangePercent(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, float cr) {
182//              if (cr > 0) {
183//                      System.out.println("wefwefe");
184//              }
185                float movementChange = 0f;
186                float d = getDegradeThreshold(stats);
187                float i = getImproveThreshold(stats);
188                if (cr < d) {
189                        float f = (d - cr) / d;
190                        movementChange = -1f * f * MAX_MOVEMENT_CHANGE;
191                } else if (cr > i) {
192                        float f = (cr - i) / (1f - i);
193                        movementChange = 1f * f * MAX_MOVEMENT_CHANGE;
194                }
195                return movementChange;
196        }
197        
198        private float getDamageTakenChangePercent(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, float cr) {
199                float damageTakenChange = 0f;
200                float d = getDegradeThreshold(stats);
201                float i = getImproveThreshold(stats);
202                if (cr < d) {
203                        float f = (d - cr) / d;
204                        damageTakenChange = 1f * f * MAX_DAMAGE_TAKEN_CHANGE;
205                } else if (cr > i) {
206                        float f = (cr - i) / (1f - i);
207                        damageTakenChange = -1f * f * MAX_DAMAGE_TAKEN_CHANGE;
208                }
209                return damageTakenChange;
210        }

212        private float getRefitTimeChangePercent(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, float cr) {
213                float refitTimeChange = 0f;
214                float d = getDegradeThreshold(stats);
215                float i = getImproveThreshold(stats);
216                if (cr < d) {
217                        float f = (d - cr) / d;
218                        refitTimeChange = 1f * f * MAX_REFIT_CHANGE;
219                } else if (cr > i) {
220                        float f = (cr - i) / (1f - i);
221                        refitTimeChange = -1f * f * MAX_REFIT_CHANGE;
222                }
223                return refitTimeChange;
224        }

252         * From negative whatever to best accuracy of 1.
253         * @param cr

256        private float getAimAccuracy(float cr) {
257                return Math.max(0f, cr * 1.5f - 0.5f);
258        }

260        public void applyCRToStats(float cr, MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize) {
261                String id = "cr_effect";
262                //System.out.println("CR: " + cr);
263                boolean fighter = hullSize == HullSize.FIGHTER;
264
265//              if (hullSize == HullSize.CAPITAL_SHIP) {
266//                      System.out.println("Applying CR value of " + cr + " to stats " + stats + "(" + hullSize.name() + ")");
267//                      //new RuntimeException().printStackTrace();
268//              }
269
270                if (!fighter) {
271                        if (cr < getMalfunctionThreshold(stats)) {
272                                stats.getWeaponMalfunctionChance().modifyFlat(id, 0.01f * getWeaponMalfuctionPercent(stats, cr));
273                                stats.getEngineMalfunctionChance().modifyFlat(id, 0.01f * getEngineMalfuctionPercent(stats, cr));
274                        } else {
275                                stats.getWeaponMalfunctionChance().unmodify(id);
276                                stats.getEngineMalfunctionChance().unmodify(id);
277                        }
278                }
279                
280                if (!fighter) {
281                        if (cr < getCriticalMalfunctionThreshold(stats)) {
282                                stats.getCriticalMalfunctionChance().modifyFlat(id, 0.01f * getCriticalMalfuctionPercent(stats, cr));
283                        } else {
284                                stats.getCriticalMalfunctionChance().unmodify(id);
285                        }
286                }
287                
288                if (!fighter) {
289                        if (cr < getShieldMalfunctionThreshold(stats)) {
290                                stats.getShieldMalfunctionChance().modifyFlat(id, 0.01f * getShieldMalfuctionPercent(stats, cr));
291                                stats.getShieldMalfunctionFluxLevel().modifyFlat(id, 0.75f);
292                        } else {
293                                stats.getShieldMalfunctionChance().unmodify(id);
294                                stats.getShieldMalfunctionFluxLevel().unmodify(id);
295                        }
296                }
297        
298                if (!fighter) {
299                        if (stats.getEntity() instanceof ShipAPI) {
300                                ShipAPI ship = (ShipAPI)stats.getEntity();
301                                if (cr <= NO_SYSTEM_THRESHOLD) {
302                                        ship.setShipSystemDisabled(true);
303                                        ship.setDefenseDisabled(true);
304                                } else {
305                                        ship.setShipSystemDisabled(false);
306                                        ship.setDefenseDisabled(false);
307                                }
308                        }
309                }
310                
311                float movementChange = getMovementChangePercent(stats, cr);
312                float damageTakenChange = getDamageTakenChangePercent(stats, cr);
313                float damageChange = getDamageChangePercent(stats, cr);
314                float refitTimeChange = getRefitTimeChangePercent(stats, cr);
315                
316                if (refitTimeChange != 0) {
317                        stats.getFighterRefitTimeMult().modifyPercent(id, refitTimeChange);
318                } else {
319                        stats.getFighterRefitTimeMult().unmodify(id);
320                }
321                
322                if (movementChange != 0) {
323                        stats.getMaxSpeed().modifyPercent(id, movementChange);
324                        stats.getAcceleration().modifyPercent(id, movementChange);
325                        stats.getDeceleration().modifyPercent(id, movementChange);
326                        stats.getTurnAcceleration().modifyPercent(id, movementChange);
327                        stats.getMaxTurnRate().modifyPercent(id, movementChange);
328                } else {
329                        stats.getMaxSpeed().unmodify(id);
330                        stats.getAcceleration().unmodify(id);
331                        stats.getDeceleration().unmodify(id);
332                        stats.getTurnAcceleration().unmodify(id);
333                        stats.getMaxTurnRate().unmodify(id);
334                }
335                
336                if (damageTakenChange != 0) {
337                        stats.getArmorDamageTakenMult().modifyPercent(id, damageTakenChange);
338                        stats.getHullDamageTakenMult().modifyPercent(id, damageTakenChange);
339                        stats.getShieldDamageTakenMult().modifyPercent(id, damageTakenChange);
340                } else {
341                        stats.getArmorDamageTakenMult().unmodify(id);
342                        stats.getHullDamageTakenMult().unmodify(id);
343                        stats.getShieldDamageTakenMult().unmodify(id);
344                }
345                
346                if (damageChange != 0) {
347                        stats.getBallisticWeaponDamageMult().modifyPercent(id, damageChange);
348                        stats.getEnergyWeaponDamageMult().modifyPercent(id, damageChange);
349                        stats.getMissileWeaponDamageMult().modifyPercent(id, damageChange);
350                } else {
351                        stats.getBallisticWeaponDamageMult().unmodify(id);
352                        stats.getEnergyWeaponDamageMult().unmodify(id);
353                        stats.getMissileWeaponDamageMult().unmodify(id);
354                }
355                
356                float aimAccuracy = getAimAccuracy(cr);
357                stats.getAutofireAimAccuracy().modifyFlat(id, aimAccuracy);
358        }

360        public void applyCRToShip(float cr, ShipAPI ship) {
361                if (!ship.isFighter() && cr < getMissileAmmoReductionThreshold(ship.getMutableStats())) {
362                        for (WeaponAPI weapon : ship.getAllWeapons()) {
363                                if (weapon.getType() == WeaponType.MISSILE) {
364                                        float ammo = (float) weapon.getMaxAmmo() * getMissileLoadedFraction(ship.getMutableStats(), cr);
365                                        if (ammo < 0) ammo = 0;
366                                        weapon.setAmmo(Math.round(ammo));
367                                }
368                        }
369                }
370                ship.setCRAtDeployment(cr);
371                
372                float c = getCriticalMalfunctionThreshold(ship.getMutableStats());
373                if (cr < c && !ship.controlsLocked() && !ship.isFighter()) {
374                        float severity = (c - cr) / (c);
375                        if (Global.getCombatEngine() != null) { // can be null if coming from refit on a fresh app start in campaign
376                                
377                                float criticalMult = 1f;
378                                for (StatMod mod : ship.getMutableStats().getCriticalMalfunctionChance().getMultMods().values()) { 
379                                        criticalMult *= mod.getValue();
380                                }
381                                severity *= criticalMult;
382                                Global.getCombatEngine().addPlugin(new LowCRShipDamageSequence(ship, severity));
383                        }
384                }
385        }
386        
387        public float getMissileLoadedFraction(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, float cr) {
388                if (true) return 1f;
389                float test = Global.getSettings().getFloat("noDeployCRPercent") * 0.01f;
390                float f = (cr - test) / (getMissileAmmoReductionThreshold(stats) - test);
391                if (f > 1) f = 1;
392                if (f < 0) f = 0;
393                return f;
394        }

397        public float getMalfunctionThreshold(MutableShipStatsAPI stats) {
398                float mult = 1f;
399                if (stats != null) mult *= stats.getDynamic().getStat(Stats.CR_MALFUNCION_RANGE).getModifiedValue();
400                return MALFUNCTION_START * mult - 0.001f;
401        }

405                return CRITICAL_MALFUNCTION_START * mult - 0.001f;
406        }

433        /**
434         * @param cr from 0 to 1
435         * @param shipOrWing "ship" or "fighter wing".
436         * @return
437         */
438        public CREffectDescriptionForTooltip getCREffectDescription(float cr, String shipOrWing, FleetMemberAPI member) {
439                CREffectDescriptionForTooltip result = new CREffectDescriptionForTooltip();
440                
441                List<CREffectDetail> details = getCREffectDetails(cr, member);
442                boolean hasPositive = false;
443                boolean hasNegative = false;
444                for (CREffectDetail detail : details) {
445                        if (detail.getType() == CREffectDetailType.BONUS) hasPositive = true;
446                        if (detail.getType() == CREffectDetailType.PENALTY) hasNegative = true;
447                }
448                
449                float noDeploy = Global.getSettings().getFloat("noDeployCRPercent") * 0.01f;
450                String crStr = (int)(cr * 100f) + "%";
451                String str;
452                if (cr < noDeploy) {
453                        str = String.format("The %s is not ready for combat and can not be deployed in battle.", shipOrWing);
454                } else if (cr < getCriticalMalfunctionThreshold(member.getStats())) {
455                        str = String.format("The %s suffers from degraded performance and runs the risk of permanent and damaging malfunctions if deployed.", shipOrWing);
456                } else if (cr < getMalfunctionThreshold(member.getStats())) {
457                        str = String.format("The %s suffers from degraded performance and runs the risk of weapon and engine malfunctions during combat.", shipOrWing);
458                } else if (cr < getDegradeThreshold(member.getStats()) && hasNegative) {
459                        str = String.format("The %s suffers from degraded performance during combat.", shipOrWing);
460                } else if (cr < getImproveThreshold(member.getStats()) || !hasPositive) {
461                        str = String.format("The %s has standard combat performance.", shipOrWing);
462                } else {
463                        str = String.format("The %s benefits from improved combat performance.", shipOrWing);
464                }
465                
466                //result.getHighlights().add(crStr);
467                
468
469                if (member.isFighterWing()) {
470                        boolean canReplaceFighters = false;
471                        FleetDataAPI data = member.getFleetData();
472                        if (data != null) {
473                                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : data.getMembersListCopy()) {
474                                        if (curr.isMothballed()) continue;
475                                        if (curr.getNumFlightDecks() > 0) {
476                                                canReplaceFighters = true;
477                                                break;
478                                        }
479                                }
480                        }
481                        if (canReplaceFighters) {
482                                details.add(new CREffectDetail("", "", CREffectDetailType.NEUTRAL));
483                                float costPer = member.getStats().getCRPerDeploymentPercent().computeEffective(member.getVariant().getHullSpec().getCRToDeploy()) / 100f;
484                                String numStr = "" + (int) Math.ceil((float)((int) (cr * 100f)) / (costPer * 100f));
485                                
486                                str += " " + numStr + " fighter chassis are ready to replace combat losses.";
487                                result.getHighlights().add(numStr);
488                                
489                        } else {
490                                details.add(new CREffectDetail("Replacement chassis", "None", CREffectDetailType.PENALTY));
491                                str += " " + "Fighter losses can not be replaced due to the lack of a ship with proper facilities (i.e. a flight deck).";
492                        }
493                }
494                
495                
496                result.setString(str);
497                
498                return result;
499        }
500        
501        private String getMalfunctionString(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, float cr) {
502                String malfStr = "None";
503                float min = getCriticalMalfunctionThreshold(stats);
504                float max = getMalfunctionThreshold(stats);
505                if (cr < min) {
506                        malfStr = "Critical";
507                } else if (cr < (min + max) / 2f) {
508                        malfStr = "Serious";
509                } else if (cr < max) {
510                        malfStr = "Low";
511                }
512                return malfStr;
513        }

515        public List<CREffectDetail> getCREffectDetails(float cr, FleetMemberAPI member) {
516                List<CREffectDetail> result = new ArrayList<CREffectDetail>();
517                
518                int engine = (int) getEngineMalfuctionPercent(member.getStats(), cr);
519                int weapon = (int) getWeaponMalfuctionPercent(member.getStats(), cr);
520                
521                int speed = (int) Math.round(getMovementChangePercent(member.getStats(), cr));
522                int damage = (int) Math.round(getDamageTakenChangePercent(member.getStats(), cr));
523                int damageDealt = (int) Math.round(getDamageChangePercent(member.getStats(), cr));
524                int refit = (int) Math.round(getRefitTimeChangePercent(member.getStats(), cr));
525                
526                float acc = getAimAccuracy(cr);
527                
528                String malfStr = getMalfunctionString(member.getStats(), cr);
529                
530                String accString;
531                CREffectDetailType accType;
532                if (acc <= 0) {
533                        accString = "Very poor";
534                        accType = CREffectDetailType.PENALTY;
535                } else if (acc < 0.25f) {
536                        accString = "Poor";
537                        accType = CREffectDetailType.PENALTY;
538                } else if (acc < 0.67) {
539                        accString = "Standard";
540                        accType = CREffectDetailType.NEUTRAL;
541                } else {
542                        accString = "Excellent";
543                        accType = CREffectDetailType.BONUS;
544                }
545                
546                String speedStr = speed + "%";
547                if (speed >= 0) {
548                        speedStr = "+" + speedStr;
549                }
550                String damageStr = damage + "%";
551                if (damage >= 0) {
552                        damageStr = "+" + damageStr;
553                }
554                String rofStr = damageDealt + "%";
555                if (damageDealt >= 0) {
556                        rofStr = "+" + rofStr;
557                }
558                
559                String refitStr = refit + "%";
560                if (refit >= 0) {
561                        refitStr = "+" + refitStr;
562                }
563                
564                result.add(new CREffectDetail("Speed & maneuverability", speedStr, getTypeFor(speed, false)));
565                result.add(new CREffectDetail("Damage taken", damageStr, getTypeFor(damage, true)));
566                result.add(new CREffectDetail("Damage dealt", rofStr, getTypeFor(damageDealt, false)));
567                
568                if (member.getNumFlightDecks() > 0) {
569                        result.add(new CREffectDetail("Fighter refit time", refitStr, getTypeFor(refit, true)));
570                }
571                
572                result.add(new CREffectDetail("Autofire accuracy", accString, accType));
573                
574
575                
576                CREffectDetailType malfType = CREffectDetailType.NEUTRAL;
577                if (getWeaponMalfuctionPercent(member.getStats(), cr) > 0) {
578                        malfType = CREffectDetailType.PENALTY;
579                }
580
581                result.add(new CREffectDetail("Malfunction risk", malfStr, malfType));
582                
583                Collection<String> slots = member.getVariant().getFittedWeaponSlots();
584                boolean hasMissiles = false;
585                for (String slotId : slots) {
586                        WeaponSpecAPI w = member.getVariant().getWeaponSpec(slotId);
587                        if (w.getType() == WeaponType.MISSILE) {
588                                hasMissiles = true;
589                                break;
590                        }
591                }
592                if (hasMissiles) {
593                        float missileFraction = getMissileLoadedFraction(member.getStats(), cr);
594                        if (missileFraction < 0) missileFraction = 0;
595                        String missileStr = (int)(missileFraction * 100f) + "%";
596                        
597                        if (missileFraction < 1f) {
598                                result.add(new CREffectDetail("Missile magazines", missileStr, missileFraction < 1 ? CREffectDetailType.PENALTY : CREffectDetailType.NEUTRAL));
599                        }
600                }
601                
602                return result;
603        }
604        
605        private CREffectDetailType getTypeFor(int val, boolean invert) {
606                if (invert) {
607                        if (val < 0) return CREffectDetailType.BONUS;
608                        else if (val > 0) return CREffectDetailType.PENALTY;
609                        return CREffectDetailType.NEUTRAL;
610                } else {
611                        if (val > 0) return CREffectDetailType.BONUS;
612                        else if (val < 0) return CREffectDetailType.PENALTY;
613                        return CREffectDetailType.NEUTRAL;
614                }
615        }

638        public boolean isOkToPermanentlyDisable(ShipAPI ship, Object module) {
639                return isOkToPermanentlyDisableStatic(ship, module);
640        }
641        
642        public static boolean isOkToPermanentlyDisableStatic(ShipAPI ship, Object module) {
643                if (module instanceof ShipEngineAPI) {
644                        float fractionIfDisabled = ((ShipEngineAPI) module).getContribution() + ship.getEngineFractionPermanentlyDisabled();
645                        if (fractionIfDisabled > 0.66f) {
646                                return false;
647                        } else {
648                                return true;
649                        }
650                }
651                
652                if (module instanceof WeaponAPI) {
653                        WeaponType type = ((WeaponAPI)module).getType();
654                        if (type == WeaponType.DECORATIVE || type == WeaponType.LAUNCH_BAY || type == WeaponType.SYSTEM) {
655                                return false;
656                        }
657                        
658                        if (ship.getCurrentCR() <= 0) {
659                                return true;
660                        }
661                        
662                        List<Object> usableWeapons = new ArrayList<Object>();
663                        for (WeaponAPI weapon : ship.getAllWeapons()) {
664                                if (weapon.isPermanentlyDisabled()) continue;
665                                if (weapon.isDecorative()) continue;
666                                if (weapon.getSlot().isSystemSlot()) continue;
667                                if (weapon.getSlot().isDecorative()) continue;
668                                if (weapon.getSlot().isStationModule()) continue;
669                                if (weapon.getAmmo() > 0 && (weapon.getMaxAmmo() > 20 || weapon.getSpec().getAmmoPerSecond() > 0)) {
670                                        usableWeapons.add(weapon);
671                                }
672                        }
673                        usableWeapons.remove(module);
674                        
675                        return usableWeapons.size() >= 1;
676                }
677                return false;
678        }
